statement.p: For each of the vector fields below, decide if they have a nonzero or zero curl at the origin. Each vector field is shown in the xy-plane; they have no z-component and are independent of z. Note that the vector fields are shown with a dot at the tail of each vector.

image.description: A vector field with a slight counterclockwise rotation around the origin that increases in strength as the points get closer to the origin.
A vector field symmetric about the horizontal axis that points to the right and down for positive y values and to the right and up for negative y values.
A vector field symmetric about the vertical axis that points to the right and up for positive x values and to the left and up for negative x values.

statement.p:
Vector field (a) has
?
nonzero
zero curl at the origin.

Vector field (b) has
?
nonzero
zero curl at the origin.

Vector field (c) has
?
nonzero
zero curl at the origin.

static.solution:
(a) has zero curl at the origin.
Vector field (b) has nonzero curl at the origin.
Vector field (c) has nonzero curl at the origin.
